text.text_excerpt: Thai Mint is my favorite Thai restaurant in the city! My personal favorite dish is the Pad Kee Mao (sometimes called Drunken Noodle at some restaurants if you're looking for a comparable dish) with tofu but the Pad Thai and curries are great too! All the veggies they use are always so fresh and tasty too! During lunch, the servings are a little smaller but they also give you a little crispy spring roll and a cup of Tom Yum soup (hot and sour style soup) which is a great deal. The staff is very nice and always very accommodating when I ask for things like tofu or no egg. They'll often double check with you about other dietary restrictions if you mention one (e.g. asking if you want egg whe...

Great spot for lunch, service is quick and food is good. They make some of the better red curry compared to other thai places in NOLA. The pad see u was also pretty damn good. As seems to be with thai places in the city, if you want spicy Thai food you'll have to request it as such. Their regular isn't the least bit spicy. Overall this place ranks 2nd on my Thai food list (right behind Sukho Thai).

We went last night for dinner. The service was very nice and the food came quickly. We had the crab roll, hot and sour, coconut shrimp soup, Tom yum zen and pad Thai. The portions were generous and everything was very fresh and delicious! I loved both soups, I would order those by the pail if I could. I only tried the pad Thai out of the entrees and it was very tasty with excellent fresh shrimp, but I found it a little on the sweet side. We'll be back for sure!
